title.suggested: Tom Allen and Jem Mace Matched for $5,000

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported from Chicago that a $5,000 match between Tom Allen and Jem Mace was made for May 20, with Barney Aaron acting for Allen and Harry Hill for Mace.

metadata.notes: Page header reads 'The St. Louis Republican, Friday Morning, November 19, 1875'; filed as Missouri Republican per pre-1888 rule, not the later St. Louis Republic

facts.fact: A match for $5,000 between Allen and Jem Mace was made in Chicago to take place May 20, 1876, with Barney Aaron acting for Allen and Harry Hill of New York for Mace; a forfeit was put up

notes: Dispatch dated Nov. 18 says 'to-day'; the Chicago Times account (528) puts the meeting on Nov. 17.
